title: The Fastest Apple Mac is an Amiga - Fact or Fiction?
summary: RMC tests running a classic 68k Mac environment through emulation on an accelerated Amiga and compares it to real Mac hardware. It explores whether an Amiga can be the fastest classic Mac.
why: Cited as the evidence for the quirky claim that an accelerated Amiga is the fastest classic Mac.

quote.text: basically an Amiga with an accelerator card potentially makes for the fastest environment to run 68k-based Mac OS
